enhancerModes.title: Full model on the neural chip
enhancerModes.body: Phones with a supported Snapdragon or Dimensity neural chip run the full model there. The main processor stays free and battery use stays low.
enhancerModes.needs: Snapdragon 7 Gen 1 or newer, or Dimensity 7300 or newer.

enhancerModes.title: Lite mode on the main processor
enhancerModes.body: Every other phone runs a smaller model on the main processor. Google Pixel, Samsung Exynos and older Snapdragon phones work this way.
enhancerModes.needs: Any 64-bit phone on Android 8.0 or newer.

systemRequirements.label: Android
systemRequirements.note: Every feature of the player runs on it. AI Enhancer picks its mode from the processor.

systemRequirements.label: Audio AI Enhancer works on
systemRequirements.note: Hi-res PCM and DSD play untouched. It also stays off with Bit-perfect lock and during AI Karaoke.

systemRequirements.label: If the phone falls behind
systemRequirements.note: When the phone cannot keep up in real time, AI Enhancer turns off. You hear the original track, never a dropout.

systemRequirements.label: USB DAC
systemRequirements.note: Plug in over USB-C or an OTG adapter. No driver needed.

systemRequirements.label: Download and privacy
systemRequirements.note: The model downloads once for your chip. After that it runs on the phone and works offline.
